about: Pass 9 (2026-10-10): LiveBench release 2024-08-31 replaces the 2024-07-26 rows proposed in pass 8 (owner choice: the later release). benchmarks.name: LiveBench 2024-08-31
benchmarks.description: LiveBench release 2024-08-31 overall average (0–1): the 1,000 public questions live at that release (math 232, reasoning 150, coding 128, language 140, data analysis 150, instruction following 200; the 2024-08-31 update refreshed AMPS_Hard, olympiad (IMO/USAMO 2024) and math_comp (reordered AMC 2023) questions), objective ground-truth scoring, mean of the six category means where each category is the mean of its task means (LiveBench show_livebench_result.py). Not merged with livebench-20240726 or livebench-20241125 (different question sets). Recorded only for models with no 2024-07-26 result (one LiveBench release per model, so overlapping releases don't count twice).

gaps.why: undated Cohere API aliases; the 136 math questions added in this release were answered on 2024-08-31, one day after Command R/R+ 08-2024 launched, so the alias target is uncertain (the dated 08-2024 entries are included separately)
undated xAI names; catalogue has grok-2-0813 / grok-2-mini-0813 (August snapshots) and grok-2-1212, and nothing pins which model served 'grok-2' in mid-October 2024
undated DeepSeek API aliases (deepseek-chat also has 50 duplicate judgments)
duplicate judgments (re-runs straddling the July-2024 Phi-3 weight update)
aliases or experimental snapshots not in catalogue
